escena: SCENE (Efeonce studio in Santiago, the moment a client team approves the campaign route): two people stand at the far end of a long dark walnut table covered with printed key-visual proofs; a strategist in a plain charcoal knit is caught at the exact moment she lifts one proof and turns it toward a client in a cream shirt, who leans in, reaching for it and laughing. One low practical lamp on the table, rigged below chest height at the right, is the key light and rakes across the proofs, their hands and faces. One plain azure-blue (#0375DB) folder on the table carries the only blue. Contemporary room: bare dark walls, no plants, no books, no framed art. 50mm f/2. Nobody looks at the lens. Proofs carry only tiny, out-of-focus illegible marks, unbranded.

lecho.objeto: the near end of the dark walnut table, dissolved into blur and outside every beam

texto.muro: the calm, evenly shadowed bare dark wall
